title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array II
summary: Decide whether target occurs in a rotated nondecreasing array.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–5000 entries in [−10000,10000]. target is in the same range. The rotation may leave the sorted array unchanged.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned bool.

statement: Decide whether target occurs in a rotated nondecreasing array. Rotation keeps the internal order of the two resulting pieces. Repeated values are allowed.

examples.explanation: The target is inside the smaller rotated piece.
Shrinking duplicate boundaries eventually proves absence.
A singleton may contain the target.

constraints: 1–5000 entries in [−10000,10000]. target is in the same range. The rotation may leave the sorted array unchanged.
hints: Conceptual: Duplicates can hide which half is sorted.
Directional: Use sorted-half comparisons when the endpoints distinguish the halves.
Implementation: If the low, middle, and high values match, shrink both ends. Otherwise identify a sorted half and test whether target lies inside its value range.
complexityAnalysis: O(log n) time when halves can be distinguished, O(n) worst-case with duplicates, O(1) auxiliary space.
